institution_profile.official_name: SRM Institute of Science and Technology

executive_leadership.domain: Macro-direction of the university, institutional vision, multi-million rupee infrastructure funding, and broad political alliances.
International relations, global curriculum overhauls, Semester Abroad Program (SAP) alliances, and foreign university MoUs.
Daily institutional operations, regulatory audits (NIRF, NAAC), high-stakes crises, and approval of specialized B.Tech branches.
Absolute control over structural data, degree issuance, official university-stamped documents, and international credit transfer paperwork.

structural_layers.function: Holds structural dominance over all engineering streams, sets academic baselines, mandates examination schedules, and controls lab budgets.
Controls independent sub-domains (e.g., Core CSE, AI/ML, Data Science). Holds veto power over internal marks, project approvals, and disciplinary actions.
Grassroots supervisor assigned to a specific batch of 60-70 students. Monitors attendance rigidly, issues hall tickets, and acts as the primary academic counselor.

academic_zones.ecosystem: High-density center for advanced computing, software engineering, overnight hackathons, and corporate coding evaluation rounds.
Initial transition zone for incoming freshmen, housing massive lecture halls, fundamental physics/chemistry labs, and the central administrative offices.
Houses heavy physical testing machinery, wind tunnels, bio-safety labs, and automotive manufacturing workshops.

social_and_networking_commons.function: Central open-air food court and social courtyard acting as the primary hub for campus networking, student club campaigning, and grassroots event mobilization.
Massive multi-story repository of resource materials, digital research bays, and silent study zones. Transforms into a high-pressure environment during End Semester Examinations.

mens_hostels.cultural_reference: Named after Vel Paari from the Sangam era.

mens_hostels.configuration: AC & Non-AC, 2 to 4 sharing, attached washrooms

womens_hostels.configuration: AC rooms, 4 sharing (bunker and non-bunker), attached washrooms

external_components: End Semester Examination (ESE) - A highly formal, 3-hour written assessment covering the entire syllabus.

attendance_barrier.consequence_of_failure: Automatic 'Detention'. The student is structurally locked out of the ESE for that specific course and must clear it via costly summer terms or contact classes.

admissions_and_intake_mechanics.exam_structure: Computer-based test covering Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics/Biology, English, and Aptitude.
admissions_and_intake_mechanics.counseling_process: Centralized online e-counseling based on the national SRMJEEE rank list to lock in campus and specialization.
admissions_and_intake_mechanics.eligibility_baseline: Minimum 60% aggregate in 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects (for core engineering).

corporate_placement_engine.operational_model: A high-volume corporate filtering machine driven by the Career Development Center.

selection_tiers.evaluation_focus: Advanced Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA), System Design, Scalability, and Optimization.
Object-Oriented Programming (OOPs), Enterprise Application Architecture, Database Design.
Basic Quantitative Aptitude, Foundational Coding Syntax, System Support, Communication.

corporate_elimination_sequence: The CGPA Gate: Premium product companies mandate a minimum CGPA of 8.5 or 9.0+ with zero active backlogs.
The Automated Technical Screen: Conducted under proctoring on platforms like HackerRank (tests logical edge-case handling under time limits).
Technical & System Design Interviews: Face-to-face deep dives into personal tech stacks, full-stack architecture, and stress questioning.

research_and_innovation_hubs.infrastructure: Operates heavy R&D centers focusing on post-graduate, doctoral, and advanced undergraduate research.
key_centers_of_excellence: Center of Excellence in Materials for Advanced Technologies (CeMAT)
CenTRe for atmOsPheric scIences and Climate studies (TROPIC)
SRM-BRIN Centre of Excellence in Automation Technologies
Centre for Analysis of Movement, Ergonomics Research and Animersion

elite_technical_research_teams.structure: Highly autonomous, student-run engineering units operating from dedicated garages.
elite_technical_research_teams.recruitment: Multi-stage recruitment drives involving advanced aptitude tests, design sprints, and high-stress interviews.

prominent_teams.team_name: Formula Student Teams (e.g., Camber Racing, 4Front Racing)
prominent_teams.operations: Design, machine, and assemble full-scale open-wheel formula race cars for international tracks. Manage own corporate sponsorships.
Design custom carbon-fiber drones, program autonomous flight controllers, and build computer vision pipelines.

mega_fest_execution_machines.structure: Grassroots operational puzzles executed by structured student councils (Domain Specialists, Joint Secretaries) bypassing normal academic schedules.

fests.operations: Coordinates nationwide coding hackathons, robotics challenges, and defense exhibitions. Students manage multi-million rupee budgets and corporate vendor logistics.
Four-day event transforming campus logistics, securing safety clearings for international celebrity artists, and managing massive crowd density across multiple open-air theaters.

international_exposure.function: Allows high-performing students to spend a semester studying at partner universities (MIT, Stanford, UC Berkeley, Harvard, NUS) and transfer credits back to SRM.
